title: When Reality TV Goes Too Far
summary: A leaked video of a domestic dispute involving ‘Mormon Wives’ star Taylor Frankie Paul prompted ABC to cancel her season of 'The Bachelorette' days before it was set to air. The shocking footage — and other recent reality scandals — reignite a conversation about the ethics of the genre.
